description: The flattened lineage of a single output column of a defining-SQL object: how it derives from its source column(s), by stable ColumnModel id rather than name. After build-time flattening the inputs name leaf source columns.

outputColumnId.description: The stable ColumnModel id of this output column, assigned from the object's bound schema.

setFunctionType.description: When the derivation kind is AGGREGATE, the name of the SQL set function (e.g. COUNT, MAX); null otherwise.

inputs.description: The source columns this output column derives from, de-duplicated in first-seen order. Empty for a LITERAL or a count(*).
